capabilities: Evaluate selected math expressions via the command palette
Insert results in the note by ending expressions with an equals sign
Copy evaluation results to the clipboard
Use built-in units, functions and constants from the fcal parser
extras: The README references external fcal documentation by link; the library name appears blank in the text where the link was removed. No settings exist at present.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute math expressions written inside a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses  to evaluate math expressions within your Obsidian notes.

summary: Plugin that evaluates math expressions in notes, with arithmetic, percentages, units, functions, constants, variables and multiline calculations.
